# Sleephealth.org

> A comprehensive resource for sleep health education, medical information, and support services operated by the Sleep & Circadian Network (WSCN).

Sleephealth.org provides evidence-based information on sleep disorders, circadian rhythm science, and the connections between sleep and overall health. The site features clinical resources, patient education, peer support programs, and collaboration with leading health organizations.

## Key Topics

- Sleep apnea
- CPAP therapy
- Circadian rhythm
- Sleep disorders
- Sleep deprivation
- Parasomnias
- Cardiovascular health
- Sleep quality
- AWAKE peer mentors
- Sleep specialists
- Sleep in children
- Light exposure
- Sleep medications
- OSA screening
- Sleep-wake cycles

## Organization & Mission

- [Our Mission](https://www.sleephealth.org/asaa/our-mission): Mission statement of WSCN nonprofit organization for sleep apnea
- [Leadership](https://www.sleephealth.org/wscn/leadership-team): WSCN leadership team and organizational staff directory

## Sleep Health Education

- [Health In Children](https://www.sleephealth.org/children): Comprehensive guide to children's sleep health and circadian rhythms
- [When To See A Sleep Specialist](https://www.sleephealth.org/2022/05/31/when-to-see-a-sleep-specialist): Guide on recognizing sleep issues and when to seek specialist care
- [Parasomnias And Mental Health: Understanding Strange Sleep Behaviors](https://www.sleephealth.org/2025/04/10/parasomnias-understanding-strange-sleep-behaviors): Analysis of parasomnias and their connection to mental health conditions
- [30-minute Afternoon Nap Tied To A Mid-day Refresh And Memory Boost](https://www.sleephealth.org/2023/03/22/30-minute-afternoon-nap-tied-to-a-mid-day-refresh-and-memory-boost): Research article on benefits of afternoon naps for cognitive performance
- [Sleeping With A Light On Could Have Negative Health Consequences](https://www.sleephealth.org/2022/03/30/40229): Research on light exposure effects on circadian rhythm and metabolic health

## Sleep & Health Conditions

- [Heart And Blood Vessel Conditions](https://www.sleephealth.org/across-the-body/heart-and-blood-vessel-conditions): Reference on cardiovascular health connections to sleep disorders
- [Struggling To Sleep? Your Heart May Pay The Price](https://www.sleephealth.org/2022/03/10/struggling-to-sleep-your-heart-may-pay-the-price): Article linking sleep deprivation to cardiovascular disease risks
- [Cancer](https://www.sleephealth.org/across-the-body/cancer): Reference on cancer prevention, sleep-wake cycles, and circadian rhythm
- [Kidney Health And Sleep Health Go Hand In Hand](https://www.sleephealth.org/2017/03/05/kidney-health-and-sleep-health-go-hand-in-hand): Article exploring the relationship between kidney health and sleep quality

## Sleep Apnea & Treatment Support

- [AWAKE Peer Mentor Program](https://www.sleephealth.org/asaa/peer-mentors): AWAKE peer mentor program providing CPAP therapy support services
- [6 Creative Ways To Show Your Gratitude On CPAP Appreciation Day](https://www.sleephealth.org/2023/04/17/6-creative-ways-to-show-your-gratitude-on-cpap-appreciation-day): CPAP Appreciation Day awareness and patient support celebration article
- [Cardiologists Have A Unique Opportunity To Boost OSA Screening And Diagnosis](https://www.sleephealth.org/2022/05/24/cardiologists-have-a-unique-opportunity-to-boost-osa-screening-and-diagnosis): Article on OSA screening collaboration between cardiology and sleep medicine

## Reference & Terminology

- [Glossary](https://www.sleephealth.org/glossary-2): Glossary of sleep medicine terminology and clinical definitions
